section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces a study exploring the relationship between goal orientation (learning vs. performance), self-leadership, and adaptive/proactive work role performances. It hypothesizes that learning orientation positively predicts performance, mediated by self-leadership behavior-focused strategies, and moderated by natural reward and thought pattern strategies. The study involved 108 workers from a software company and found that learning orientation predicted adaptive and proactive work role performance, with moderated mediation effects for proactive performance.
